<!-- generated by tools/gen-commands.py from the console grammar (.grammar). Do not edit by hand: change the grammar in the Director and regenerate. -->

The Onesimus Director (`odir`) speaks the console language of the Bareos Director. Its commands follow those of `bareos-dir`; some behave differently on purpose (see the [comparison with Bareos](/compare/)), and each command page shows the state of that command. The Onesimus GUI sends commands through its dialogs. Commands and arguments marked *Onesimus extension* exist only in the Onesimus Director.

This reference is generated from the console grammar that the Director itself prints with `.grammar`; the same grammar drives completion and help in the console. Dot commands are meant for programs such as the GUI, but you can type them as well.
